definitions.explanation: A person who has legally adopted a child and taken on the role of parent. Used in both legal and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {養親|ようしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was raised by adoptive parents.

examples.japanese: {養親|ようしん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{認|みと}められている→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: The relationship between adoptive parents and adopted children is recognized by law.

examples.japanese: {養親|ようしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, permission from the family court is required to become an adoptive parent.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and formal term. The opposite is {実親|じっしん} (biological parent). In Japanese law, there are two types of adoption: {普通養子縁組|ふつうようしえんぐみ} (ordinary adoption) and {特別養子縁組|とくべつようしえんぐみ} (special adoption), each with different legal implications for the {養親|ようしん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養親|ようしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become an adoptive parent)
- {養親|ようしん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧ (adoptive parent and adopted child)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実親|じっしん}: biological parent — the parent by birth
- ⟦{里親|さとおや}→里親：21054_satooya⟧: foster parent — may not have legal adoption status
